notes.title: LoveKami -Healing Harem- Out Now!
notes.content:
We are really excited to announce that the third installment in the LoveKami series is out now on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/938270/LoveKami_Healing_Harem/
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/1ad82ed6ca43a2b500bedff80175a83dfdbdbcb8.jpg[/img]

LoveKami -Healing Harem- is a visual novel set in the same universe as LoveKami -Divinity Stage- and LoveKami -Useless Goddess-.
With a different setting to the previous two chapters, Healing Harem introduces us to the Tatarigami, cursed Goddesses, known for spreading misfortune. 
Set in a community deep within the mountains, Akira spends most of his time listening to the goddess' troubles and helped them find solutions. 


[h1]Story Introduction[/h1]
[i]"I'll find a solution to the goddess' problems!"[/i]

The more things seem the same, the more they're actually different... 
These are some strange little stories about Goddesses in love. 
They happened in a time when Goddesses and people lived in close proximity, six years after the Goddesses descended to Earth.

Our story takes place in Kamimori City, a community deep in the mountains that is known among some people for one thing; the area is protected by a Tatarigami.
Tatarigami are known for spreading misfortune, but Kamimori City is protected by one.

He used to come every year as a child, but since entering junior high, he’s been unable to make the trip due to his parents’ work and other circumstances.
So this year, he came to the island on his own.
Having come to the island partially for a bit of self-discovery, he encounters a girl in even more need of self-discovery than himself.

Hiroki has a bright and big-hearted personality, but has some strong feelings and ideas when it comes to food.
He even plans to acquire his cook’s license and become a chef after graduating high school.

Thanks to his participation in various school sports clubs, he’s very athletic and is an excellent swimmer.
In the past, he was once scuba diving buddies with Chisa.

A deeply-tanned local girl.
The same age as her childhood friend, Hiroki, Chisa’s parents run the island diving shop.
To help her family out, she helps tourists to swim with dolphins and works a part-time job collecting mail from the underwater postbox.

She’s a bright, energetic, and healthy girl with a great figure.
She shows absolutely no signs of shyness and is able to get along with just about anyone, but at the same time she’s also able to maintain a comfortable distance.
While she tends to whine and complain, she’s also a warm-hearted person who simply can’t ignore someone in trouble.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/e2ddc7c303308e9687ff4b682de7178011a616bb.png[/img]

An extremely skilled swimmer, she can hold her breath underwater for an amazingly long time and feels most at home when in the water.
She often wears her swimsuit around town just to be able to get into the water anytime.
She can often be seen swimming together with Phin, the stray dolphin.

Something apparently happened with Hiroki way back when, and to this day she harbors feelings for him that she just can’t seem to put into words.

notes.content:
With Adventure of a Lifetime releasing on Steam on April 26th, we wanted to introduce the characters to you! 

Today we will be meeting Emily! 

[h1]Emily[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/c7e9e333bcd0a4c1d264b090d6aed000096aa05f.png[/img]

Full Name: Emily Shirase
Age: 16
Height: 162cm
B/W/H: 88/58/86
CV: Akari Kito

[quote][i]“There’s something I need to get back. Something precious that sank into the ocean years ago."[/i][/quote]

A young girl in a high school uniform, with blonde hair and blue eyes.
This half-Japanese, half-American girl Hiroki meets on the ferry heading to the island says she’s on her way to Ogasawara, which has a special place in her parents’ hearts.

Possibly due to the fact that she basically ran away from home to make the journey, at first she seems extremely suspicious of those around her, and she has quite the attitude.
Every once in awhile, she shows signs of something troubling her, deep down inside.
However, while her personality is actually somewhat shy, she also has a bit of naiveté about her and forges ahead full of baseless confidence.
Coming from a wealthy family and fortunate enough to be aesthetically stunning, she sometimes also shows flashes of a “less fortunate” side as well.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/553336183ad008a570fcbb2f183f2305c58886c6.png[/img]

Emily ends up working a part-time job at Hiroki’s grandmother’s cafe, Machiko’s Cafe.

She’s also a total beginner at diving.
Due to her fear of sharks, she’s also afraid of the sea in general, and is completely unable to swim.
But thanks to the support of her friends and a stray dolphin, she manages to overcome her fears.
